thesis: This episode argues that venture capital has produced massive success stories like Coinbase and Microsoft, creating zero-marginal-cost businesses and billion-dollar entities. It contrasts these winners with slower technologies like Ethereum and questions whether the market can support 50 to 100 more companies of Google or Facebook's scale.
